verdict.rationale: mParticle documents connecting audiences to audience outputs, meaning ad and engagement partners chosen from the integrations directory, so audience activation is a first-party capability. Nothing in the pack shows that sync is continuous or that members enter and exit in near-real-time. missing for 10: documented continuous or real-time audience sync cadence, evidence of membership exit/removal propagation to destinations, named ad-platform and engagement-tool destinations, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a marketer, audiences sync to ad platforms and engagement tools continuously, with membership entering and exiting in near-real-time

citations.quote: Once you have created an audience, you must connect it to an audience output where you can activate it.
Score likelihood to churn, convert, or grow in value, then activate audiences before risk or opportunity passes.
